body:
A little bit of background first. I am an 18 year old college freshman. I am experienced with weed, LSD, DMT, DXM, and a number of prescription painkillers, benzodiazepines, and stimulants. I currently smoke weed regularly, vape nicotine salts daily, and recently got a prescription for 20 mg Vyvanse daily for ADHD. Recently, I made a decent profit trading cryptocurrency, and I decided to try something new and spend some of my profits on some deep web cocaine. I found a vendor selling $60 grams, and placed an order. About a week later, I checked my mail and it had arrived. The trip report below details my experience with this new substance to me.
T+0:00 Around noon today, I had an appointment with my colleges psychiatrist to try to get some ADHD medication. This was pretty easy, as I was diagnosed with ADHD in high school and had a prescription until my parents decided to take me off the pills before my senior year of high school. Immediately following the appointment, I popped one pill as I had a paper to write and a midterm the next day to prepare for.
T+0:45 At my desk working, I begin to feel the familiar feeling of amphetamine kicking in. Im writing a paper and my hands are flying across the keyboard. Ideas were just flowing through my brain into my hands and into my laptop. I took a rip off my vape and felt even better. Prior to this, I had not taken amphetamine in almost two years, so I had absolutely no tolerance.
T+1:30 My roommate left for class, which meant I was free to play loud music and do what I wanted. Recently I had been struggling with depression, and as a result my room had become pretty messy. Today, the Vyvanse motivated me to clean up my entire room, filling up an entire trash bag with papers, empty water and soda bottles, and other random assorted trash. I then folded and put away the mountain of laundry that I had previously been too lazy to fold. As I did all of these tasks, I happily moved about my room singing along with the classic rock playing from my speaker. I was definitely high at this point.
T+3:00 Spent the last hour studying for my midterm. Was super productive and felt prepared for the test tomorrow. At this point one of my friends, J (a non drug user), invited me to play ping pong with him in our dorms lobby. On the way down, I checked my mail box and saw that two packages had arrived. I set them aside to open later and played ping pong with J. My reflexes were significantly heightened. I was returning everything and hitting incredible shots. J was wondering why I was playing so good so I told him that I started back on ADHD medication today.
T+3:45 We finish playing ping pong and its almost time for me to go to class. I went upstairs to my room to get ready, bringing my two packages with me. I opened the packages and saw that the gram of coke and some edibles I had ordered arrived. I decided that I did not want to wait until after class to try it, so I took two bumps off a credit card and went to class.
T+4:00 At this point, I am definitely feeling the cocaine. Class was super interesting and I was especially engaged and focused. I felt a noticeable euphoria. Life is good.
I am definitely feeling the cocaine. Class was super interesting and I was especially engaged and focused. I felt a noticeable euphoria. Life is good.
T+5:00 Class is over. The cocaine is definitely wearing off at this point, but I still felt stimulated from the Vyvanse I took earlier. I headed back to my room and talked to my roommate.
T+5:30 My roommate left for class again, which meant I was free to chop up a line on my desk and go crazy. Because I was relatively new to snorting drugs, I stuck to smaller lines about the size of a matchstick.
T+6:00 I took another line and was immediately sent back into a state of blissful stimulated euphoria. At this point, it was dinner time, so I walked to the campus dining hall with my friend J from before. Because of the appetite suppressant effects of the stimulants I was taking, I was not very hungry, but forced myself to eat a chicken sandwich and some fries.
T+7:00 Finished dinner and returned to my dorm room. Once again, the effects of the cocaine are fading, and the amphetamine buzz seems weaker as well. My roommate is back, so I hold off on redosing until he leaves for dinner at about T+7:45.
T+8:00 Feeling pretty stimulated from the most recent line I took, I head to my evening philosophy discussion class. Class was super interesting once again, and I found myself playing a significant role in the conversations, which was extremely unusual for me.
T+9:00 Done with class for the day. Cocaine high wearing off again, and the amphetamine high is completely gone. I took a key bump in the bathroom before returning to my dorm room and studying for my midterm again.
T+9:00-T+11:00 Spent the last two hours taking key bumps when my roommate wasnt paying attention and doing schoolwork. All in all, it was pretty enjoyable and I felt like I accomplished a lot.
T+12:00 Roommate left to take a shower so I railed two decent sized lines. Spent the last hour listening to music and writing this report. All in all, I had a pretty good experience with cocaine.
